commands.proxiability_note: TS 29.273 V19.2.0 section 8.2.2.2 omits PXY from PPR but includes it in PPA; section 8.2.2.3 uses PXY in SAR/SAA. Require PXY for both PPR and PPA under RFC 6733 section 6.2, which requires the answer P bit to match the request. The omission persists in every published version since V8.0.0. Cx PPR also uses command 305 with REQ, PXY (TS 29.229 V19.1.0 section 6.1.11). RFC 6733 section 3 requires local processing when P is clear. With ValidateRequests enabled a P-clear SWx PPR is answered with DIAMETER_INVALID_HDR_BITS (3008).
